'''Chen Ming-di''' was a [[Historian/Legends|historian]]. Ming-di was the author of ''[[Imperial Atrocities and Other Noble Pursuits]]'', a history of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] brutality over the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of its reign. The narrative detailed events such as the [[Battle of Ebenmal|capture]] of the legendary [[Citadel of Ebenmal]] and the brutal subjugation of [[Rhador]], where [[carbonite war droid]]s froze its inhabitants in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].
